svg.title: Outcome mix, A vs B
svg.desc: How do the two outcome mixes differ on the same tasks? tokens-0: haiku 65%, sonnet 67% passed; tokens-25000: haiku 62%, sonnet 58% passed; tokens-50000: haiku 59%, sonnet 63% passed; tokens-100000: haiku 63%, sonnet 64% passed; tokens-200000: haiku 59%, sonnet 64% passed; all runs: haiku 62%, sonnet 63% passed

g.text: The same shared tasks under each side: pass on the left, failures grow from the right edge, worst last. Bars of one
run are aligned, so a longer segment is more of that outcome.
